construct_optimizer: construct an OmniOptimizer from a model and Hydra config with optional scheduler options and param group modifiers
create_lars_optimizer: create a LARS-wrapped optimizer by instantiating an optimizer config and wrapping it with LARS
validate_param_group_params: validate that parameter groups are disjoint and cover all model parameters
unix_param_pattern_to_parameter_names: match model parameter names against Unix glob patterns from a scheduler config
map_scheduler_cfgs_to_param_groups: map scheduler configs to optimizer param groups by intersecting parameter name constraints
